**Scope check**

- [ ] Works on Windows XP SP3 x86 (no API newer than .NET 4.0 / no post-XP system DLL)
- [ ] Works in both the CLI and the GUI, or clearly documented as one of them only
- [ ] No new runtime dependency, or the dependency is optional and shipped under `deps\`
- [ ] Testable through the existing suites (a failing case is a good argument for the change)
